description.content: Current US Department of State travel advisories for countries worldwide, with alert levels ranging from 1 (Exercise Normal Precautions) to 4 (Do Not Travel)

Returns current travel advisories for all countries worldwide. Each advisory includes the country name, alert level (1-4), publication date, last updated timestamp, and detailed summary of risks including crime, terrorism, health threats, civil unrest, and kidnapping.

response.name: Array of travel advisory objects for all countries

description.content: Returns the current travel advisory for a specific country identified by its two-letter ISO country code. Includes alert level (1-4), risk summary, and key risk categories.

variable.description: (Required) Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., NG for Nigeria, FR for France)
